## Change

What problem does this solve, and what behavior changes? Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

List the commands and results you actually checked, plus browser/device details when relevant. Explain anything that could not be tested.

- [ ] Relevant automated checks pass (`npm run check`, `npm run docs:check`, `npm run format:check`).
- [ ] Dynamics changes include physical behavior tests and numerical verification, where applicable.
- [ ] UI or hardware changes include the relevant manual acceptance checks, where available.

## Sources and limits

For aircraft, component data or assets, identify sources, reuse terms and which parameters remain estimates. Describe compatibility changes and anything still unverified. Mock input or compilation does not count as a physical hardware test.
